topics.title: Gay Letter & Shaving Secrets
topics.summary: Howard discovers an old letter from a gay man and discusses shaving with callers, including one who describes experimenting sexually with his girlfriend while discussing it with Mark. The conversation drifts to whether men are attracted to other men's butts and explores the experiences of dating within the LGBTQ+ community, touching on topics like relationships, sexual experimentation, and societal perceptions.

topics.title: Gay Groups Protest Stern, Phone Calls
topics.summary: Following Howard Stern’s comments about gay groups protesting his Los Angeles show, a series of phone calls ensue involving Billy and Andy attempting to gauge reactions. A ‘radical and mad’ group contacts the station expressing outrage over Father Ritter segments, while another caller claiming to be from a 10% organization attempts to discuss their concerns with station officials.

topics.title: Gay Roger and the Handkerchief
topics.summary: A nervous host engages in a bizarre conversation with an unnamed guest regarding attraction to men, sexual experiences, handkerchief etiquette (specifically carrying snot-covered ones), and stereotypes of homosexual behavior. The discussion includes references to 'gaydar' and psychological theories about why some gay men might avoid commitment.

topics.title: Confessions of a Gay Man - Fantasy & Attraction
topics.summary: During an on-air conversation, the host explores his attraction to male celebrities like Tom Cruise and Michael J Fox, detailing fantasies involving fictional characters and personal experiences with homosexuality including dating habits and sexual preferences. The discussion includes reactions from family members regarding his sexuality.

topics.title: Confessions of an Apartment Dweller
topics.summary: A caller recounts their unconventional lifestyle living with three roommates in Manhattan, detailing frequent encounters and casual relationships alongside discussions about finances and career choices. The conversation includes bizarre tangents involving names like 'Ophelia' and a fascination with supermodels and motorcycle boots.

topics.title: Unscripted Sexual Discussions
topics.summary: Two individuals engage in an extended, largely incoherent conversation exploring personal experiences with sexuality and celebrity figures.
